verdict.rationale: Mercury advertises earning up to 3.89% yield through Treasury by Mercury Advisory alongside its checking and savings accounts. Its API supports internal transfers between depository accounts and a treasury/investment account in the same organization, plus treasury transaction and statement retrieval, so yield is earned without leaving Mercury. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Treasury terms (eligibility, minimums, liquidity/withdrawal timing, how the 'up to' rate is determined), explanation of how Mercury Advisory relates to the bank, independent or hands-on corroboration of yield earned.
